settings.trashNote: After this period, photos are deleted at startup. The backup is not touched.
settings.sameDisk: This folder is on the same disk as the library: if that disk fails, both copies are lost.
settings.backupHint: The backup applies to future imports; photos already imported are not copied again.
settings.templatesHint: Templates apply to future imports; photos already filed do not move.
settings.cloudBackup: Folder synced by {{service}}: Afterdusk verifies the local copy, not the upload.
settings.mapOnlineNote: Off: the map only shows the built-in borders and makes no request.
settings.logoNote: At the top of contact sheets and the gear inventory, and as a watermark. A transparent PNG works best.
settings.autoImportNone: No cameras. After importing a card, Afterdusk offers to import its cameras' next cards on its own.
settings.autoImportNote: A card from these cameras is imported as soon as it is inserted, with the settings of its first import and a default album name, unless insertion is set to “Do nothing”. The card is only read.
settings.watchNone: No folders. Add the one where your camera software (USB or Wi-Fi) saves photos.
settings.watchNote: Each complete photo is copied and verified into the album shown, in the current library, and appears in Cull within seconds. The folder is never modified; what it already contains when added is ignored.
settings.ftpEnable: Receive photos from cameras over FTP on the local network
settings.ftpOffNote: Off. For cameras that transfer over FTP via Wi-Fi or Ethernet: photos arrive in Cull during the shoot.
settings.ftpPlainWarning: With plain FTP, the password and photos travel unencrypted on the local network. Choose FTPS on the camera whenever it allows.
settings.ftpClearConfirm: Delete the files already imported from the reception folder? Files not yet in the library are kept.
settings.ftpNote: On the camera: FTP server, address and port above, passive mode, FTPS (explicit TLS). If the camera asks you to confirm the certificate, compare its fingerprint; if it asks you to import it, save it to a card. Only the local network can connect; Windows may ask to allow Afterdusk on private networks. Received files are kept until you empty the reception.
